identity.card: official_card_id plus match-scoped physical-card serial plus immutable playerIndex
identity.pre_evolution: older physical-card identities in stack order
identity.attack: strict catalog official attack ID bound to current top card and local ordinal

decision.authority_rule: P2-WP5 decision sources are shadow-only; official ordering and execution authority remain P3
decision.select_null_rule: only the initial callback conformance case may use select null

engine_capture.entrypoint: capture_engine(GameState, GodotSerialRegistry, decision_source, public_events, source_documents, step?, remainingOverageTime?)
engine_capture.state_allow_list: enumerate current public field, stadium, both public boards and discards, acting hand identities, hidden-zone counts and public flags; never enumerate opponent hand, either deck or face-down prizes into the portable snapshot
engine_capture.source_document_rule: every visible or event-authorized CardInstance must match exact source-file bytes, live CardData safe fields, strict catalog printing identity and current match-registry card handle
engine_capture.host_entity_rule: PokemonSlot registry identity is revalidated for lifecycle only and never serialized; CABT Pokemon.serial is the current top physical-card serial
engine_capture.option_identity_rule: engine attack options provide a local attack ordinal and skill options provide a direct CardInstance reference; the projector derives official attack/card IDs and serials instead of trusting caller-supplied numeric identity
engine_capture.event_source_rule: public event records use exact per-kind keys and direct CardInstance references; attack identity is derived from the strict local ordinal mapping
engine_capture.result_revalidation: the exact owner result replays against bound live state, registry, decision snapshot, event snapshot and source bytes; mutation or stale registry fails closed

public_events.legacy_game_action_rule: GameAction.data, description and local numeric card identifiers are not authority

result_contract.accepted: observation and public_observation_hash present; error_code empty; audit contains closed aggregate provenance only
result_contract.rejected: observation and public_observation_hash null; one closed error_code; no rejected value echo
result_contract.serialization_authority: audit/conformance only; serialized dictionaries never authorize window, policy or execution
result_contract.engine_capture_authority: only exact owner result retaining bound engine/catalog/registry/decision objects may be called engine-attested
